how: Tools/library/near_night.py: each event of a near preset rendered alone over the silenced background Kiln Descent, K-weighted level in 100 ms windows every 10 ms, heard over the background's loudness taken as steady; rise = steepest climb within 100 ms (dB), peak = loudest window over the mean as heard over the span within 20 dB of the peak (dB); worst event of the render
event_format: per event (near_night.py compact): onset = base64 of the levels over the background as int8 quarter decibels (-128: under -32 dB), 10 ms apart, from 0.3 s before the event to 100 ms after the fade; pairs = the pairs of windows 100 ms apart no other pair beats, as such levels; span = the windows the event is heard over; rest_* = the span's loudest window, mean (power over the background) and length after the onset
